notes.title: Daily Deal: The Pyro Bundle
notes.content:
[h3][i]Tacticians and Strategists,[/i][/h3]

experience revolutionary strategy classics of the [b]Pyro Studios[/b] team; creators of the legendary [b]Commandos[/b] series, [b]Praetorians[/b] and [b]Imperial Glory[/b].

Take your chance and get the bundle with an extra discount - for a limited time only! ⏳

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3954085/269df19762b388dd79bdde6977115f78d63dc107.png[/img]

You have been selected for active service in the Commandos Corps, and must now mobilize in a series of 8 new dangerous missions.

You may come with experience of action 'Behind Enemy Lines' or perhaps you are just a rookie - whatever you are, you will be given the opportunity to push your daring and tactical ability to the limit.
As the leader of a small elite unit operating deep within enemy territory, you will experience new challenges and goals with these new missions.

Plus new vehicles, buildings, weapons and 2 levels of difficulty will satisfy both Commandos veterans and new recruits.

[h3]Prove your tactical and strategic skills with the Pyro Bundle! 🔥[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/12326/The_Pyro_Bundle_Commandos_Praetorians__more/

notes.title: Commandos Update for Modern Computers
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

We are looking into all bug reports on our main thread. If you are experiencing any issues with the updates, please let us know here.
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/6810/discussions/0/412448158145537247/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/6810/discussions/0/412448158145537247/[/url]

[b]UPDATE - You can now access the old build via the "Legacy Version" launch option[/b]

  Thank you all for your continued support for the Commandos series, we appreciate all the feedback we have received. We have heard all of your concerns and took them on board.

  With that, we have an announcement, all of the Commandos games should now run on systems up to and including Windows 10. Significant changes have been made to the code in order to make each of the games run correctly on modern machines.

Changelog for Commandos: Beyond The Call of Duty
[list]
[*]Multicore CPU bug fix.
[*]Videos not loading bug fix.
[*]Audio bug fix regarding volume.
[*]Performance problems fixed
[*]Compatibility issues with modern hardware fixed.
[*]New, higher resolution settings (1280x720)
[*]Minor bug fixes.
[/list]

  We all hope you enjoy the update, and thanks again for all of your support!

tags.bug: Compatibility issues with modern hardware fixed.
